## Vendor emails → VendorIQ
Vendors can simply email their documents to the onboarding inbox.

1. Gmail Trigger polls the inbox every minute (downloads attachments)
2. Code node packages sender, subject, body, SPF/DKIM header and attachments
3. VendorIQ sorts the attachments with document AI, builds a draft application, or — if the subject carries `[VEN-…]` — treats it as a reply to an existing application
4. Email marked as read

**Setup:** connect Gmail on both Gmail nodes; replace `REPLACE_WITH_APP_URL` and `REPLACE_WITH_SHARED_SECRET`.
